title: Hello, world!
text: Welcome to my website! Here I’ll share notes on environmental impact assessment, ESG, climate risk and carbon accounting.

title: about
text: Environmental consultant with 8 years of experience across Asia-Pacific and Europe, combining field-based impact assessment, transaction due diligence and climate advisory with a strong quantitative toolkit (R, GIS, WindPro). Experienced in supporting clients in alignment with IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguards, Equator Principles (EP4) and ISO frameworks.

title: Truc Pham
text: I help energy developers, investors and manufacturers understand and manage their environmental, social and climate risks, from wind farms in Vietnam to carbon accounting on the streets of Warsaw.

title: Truc Pham
text:
What I do


Impact Assessment
ESIA and ESMP for wind, solar, gas and LNG-to-power projects, aligned with IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguards and Equator Principles.


Due Diligence & ESG
ESDD, ESG DD and EHS DD for M&A transactions and manufacturing assets, turning site findings into clear, investment-ready action plans.


Climate & Carbon
GHG inventories (GHG Protocol), TCFD climate risk assessments, CSRD/ESRS baselines, and carbon footprint analysis with R and GIS.


Based in Warsaw, Poland · MSc in Sustainable Development (with Distinction), University of Warsaw
